summary: Each integration test must be in exactly one CI group, such as shippable/posix/group1, picked to match similar tests or randomly if several fit.
questions: Which CI group should I put my new integration test in?

answer_card.title: CI groups
answer_card.answer_md: Add exactly one group to `aliases`, for example `shippable/posix/group1`, `shippable/windows/group2`, `shippable/aws/group1` or `shippable/cloud/group1`. Use the same group as similar tests; if several fit, pick one randomly. Groups balance CI jobs.
